t: What Air Pollution Source Database Is All About
title: What Air Pollution Source Database Is All About
description: Air pollution kills ~7 million yearly (WHO): PM2.5 (fine particles) drives the toll, ozone and NO2 follow. Sources split by sector — power, transport, industry, cooking — and by place: household biomass smoke kills millions where clean stoves are missing. London's Great Smog (1952, ~12,000 dead) birthed clean air law; the US Clean Air Act (1970) cut major pollutants ~78% while GDP tripled. This database is the complete pollution source: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
